(17) Manziga, a chief of the Azande. All important Azande chiefs in this region belong to the Avungura, the reigning clan. Most of the Azande believe that after death they will be reincarnated as animals, and the Az Avungura will then become lions. Manziga is one of the most important native chiefs around Niangara, ruling a large territory. He is unusually intelligent and exhibits much that and diplomacy in dealings with the Belgian administration.
Photograph by Herbert Lang, of The American Museum of Natural History, New York.

Down in the Belgian Congo, there lives a dusky Chieftain, Mwita Yamoe XIV (above), known as the Prince of death, argued for his wisdom, and aptitude in picking feminine pulchritude. In his career, which is over 40 years, he has married 200 belles of his part of the world, who are probably now crying, as he is suffering from as strange malady to that land, "wood alcoholism". Liking his drink, the Prince sampled a shipment from a certain bone dry nation. Now the royal tailor is figuring his profits, if he has to make 200 sets of widows weeds.
